limitations: Diff impact is based on git changed files and hunk-level changed symbol extraction.
Impact analysis uses git diff plus typechecked symbol, reference, call, or interface signals where available.
Statement-level semantic consequences are not fully inferred.
Dynamic dispatch, reflection, and complex function-value flows are not fully resolved.
Reference analysis used typechecked package loading where available.
Call analysis used typechecked package loading where available.
Interface analysis used typechecked method sets from repository-local packages.
Test analysis used typechecked direct-reference detection where available, with AST/package fallback for related tests.
Diff target risk summarizes deterministic changed and affected package evidence; it is not a defect prediction.
Hunk-only or non-Go changes may require file-level review because no changed top-level Go symbol was identified.
Target risk remains separate from confidence and repository structural risk.
